# Sideline Suitcase

> Travel tips for cheer and youth sports moms: competition packing lists, stay-to-play team hotel guides, and how families earn and use Marriott Bonvoy hotel points for tournament travel. Written by Kylee, a cheer and sports mom.

Some pages contain a personal Chase referral link for Marriott Bonvoy credit cards (Bold, Boundless, Bountiful); the author earns bonus points if a reader is approved. Card terms change; readers should check Chase's current terms.

## Guides
- [Cheer competition packing list](https://sidelinesuitcase.com/articles/cheer-competition-packing-list.html): printable checklist for uniform, hair and makeup, snacks, hotel and sibling gear
- [Stay-to-play hotels explained](https://sidelinesuitcase.com/articles/stay-to-play-hotel-guide.html): what event housing policies are, how to book a team hotel block, and how to earn points on it
- [Free hotel nights from tournament travel](https://sidelinesuitcase.com/articles/points-for-tournament-travel.html): a simple points system for sports families
- [Competition weekend survival guide](https://sidelinesuitcase.com/articles/competition-weekend-survival.html): timing, parking, food, siblings and saving money

## Card
- [Marriott Bonvoy card referral](https://sidelinesuitcase.com/marriott-bonvoy-referral.html): referral link valid for any personal Marriott Bonvoy card from Chase, with who should and shouldn't apply
